decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with vertical through contacts build directly on the firm's core glass structuring, drilling, polishing and material-matching know-how, which positions it to interpret early customer feedback and refine the product for MEMS and packaging applications, in line with its strategy of multifunctional packaging wafers.

Carrier wafers for handling smaller-diameter wafers are a close extension of the firm's established carrier and thin-wafer handling expertise, are simple to absorb and improve with existing capabilities, and fit its direction toward reusable carriers.
